content_sections.text: Advt No. F.No.10(7)2026/Estt. /ICAR-NIAPNetworkProject gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download ICAR CIFE notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Master's degree in Fisheries/Agriculture Economics or General Economics/Statistics/Computer Applications or Fisheries or Agriculture Extension Education. Age limit: 21 to 45 years Other conditions: Interview in Hybrid Mode Desirable: Well-versed in economics-related research, field data collection, data cleaning, management and analysis Proficiency in MS Excel, R and Python Working knowledge of ArcGIS/GIS and spatial data analysis Experience in digital survey/data collection tools Good skills in data visualization, report writing and preparation of research presentations

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: One year or till the termination of the Project

content_sections.heading: How Will ICAR CIFE Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Online interview based on academic performance and research experience Selection will be based on academic performance, research experience and performance during the online interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Certificates for age-related relaxations if claimed Publications if any

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR CIFE Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Get the application form: Pages 3-4 of the PDF. Fill in the form and attach the documents listed above. Email it to [email protected] . Email it on or before 29 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Only the candidates who fulfil all the eligibility conditions will be invited to appear for online interview. All invited candidates are requested to be present 10 minutes before scheduled time on the date of online interview.
